meta.pre_registered_rule: FAIL if the 95% CI upper bound of coverage < nominal - 0.05; pass if the CI lower bound >= nominal - 0.05; inconclusive in between; over-cautious if the CI lower bound > nominal + 0.05; 'covers, but too wide' if it does not fail but its interval score is more than 10% worse than the uncompressed model's
notes: Quantization is simulated: accuracy and calibration are faithful, speed is not.
Coverage is MEASURED on held-out windows; time series are not exchangeable, so no finite-sample guarantee is claimed.
